record.hypothesis: Across all four datasets, increase only the tied normalized item-embedding radius multiplier from 0.8 to 0.9, preserving width 64 and input/output tying. The regression at 0.65 motivates testing whether modestly stronger item representations improve masked-target discrimination. Keep features, topology, scoring formula, history, loss temperature and optimizer fixed; apply the same radius during training and prediction.

This tests modestly stronger item representations while preserving width, tying, features, topology, loss and optimizer.
